changes.title: Home Affairs' structure
changes.why: The Second Schedule's Ministry of Home Affairs as the states hold it (from the 1961 base and the 1970s changes) has its departments unlettered and its Parts (I, IA, II, III, IV) and Union Territory sub-headings not as the gazettes cite them; Personnel and Administrative Reforms and the Department of Home Affairs inside it are not found.

changes.title: Agriculture's departments
changes.why: The Ministry of Agriculture (and Irrigation; and Rural Development) has departments A–D, but not by the names the gazettes cite (Irrigation, Rural Development, Agricultural Research and Education): the departments' headings in the states lag behind their renames and moves.

changes.title: Planning's departments
changes.why: The Ministry of Planning's Second Schedule part holds its subjects in words, with no departments under it; the Department of Statistics and the Department of Science and Technology are cited under it.

changes.title: Departments of the top level not in the Second Schedule
changes.why: Departments the First Schedule has at the top level (Science and Technology, Space, Sports, Supply, Electronics) are not headed in the Second Schedule when a change cites them: put in by a change not read, or by one in a notification of their own.

changes.title: Finance's Department of Revenue
changes.why: The Ministry of Finance's departments read with their letters twice (A, A, B, D, D, E), the Department of Revenue not among them by that name.

changes.title: A unit cited by a name the Second Schedule does not have
changes.why: A ministry or department renamed or merged in the First Schedule, its Second Schedule heading not (or another name misread): the change cites a name not there.

changes.title: Items
changes.why: An entry's items numbered as misread ("li", "lv" for ii, iv), run into its text, or not there.

changes.title: A number twice
changes.why: Two parts with the number the change cites: an entry put in by an earlier change without the old one going, or a number misread.

changes.title: Words that differ
changes.why: The words a change substitutes, or the part it quotes, not as the states have them: a misread beyond a letter or two in one or the other, or an earlier change not applied.

changes.title: Entries not in the state
changes.why: The entry a change cites is not in the unit: missing from the reading the unit came from (the 1985 re-issue's for C2) or put in by a change not applied; beyond the unit's last, in a gap, or an "A" entry (25A, 45A).

changes.title: Group headings
changes.why: A group heading cited by its words or its numeral where the states have it otherwise.
